mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing policy, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate leverage.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which raises uncertainty about corporate earnings and compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals robust manufacturing momentum, which lowers the cost of capital and supports higher corporate valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in momentum periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,500 units signals strong consumer demand, which raises earnings expectations and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,000 units indicates weak consumer demand, which compresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or cut rates, which lowers discount rates and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tight labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
